protocol.cohort: Same incidence-selected cohort; source weights, prior .3, coupling 1 and time policy unchanged.
protocol.source_support: At least two independent paper-family means, consistent soft and win directions; absolute average soft contrast >=.01.
protocol.selection: Minimum mean whole-source-fold logloss; Brier tie-breaker. Report direction, source coverage and task breakdown, not expected model ordering.
protocol.promotion: Manufacturer blindness is a requirement. No claim of improved generalization without further unused independent source tests; old v120 holdout cannot be reused as new evidence.
protocol.new_evidence: Audit all known source identities first; reserve any untouched paper/benchmark components before reading their outcomes. Report sample insufficiency explicitly.
